## Issue summary

CSV reader crashes on rows where a quoted cell ends with a backslash followed by another quote. Specifically `"foo\\\\"\"bar"` triggers an IndexError in `_split_row` because the naive splitter doesn't fall through to csv.reader.

## Files touched

```
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
docs/CONTRIBUTING.md
```
